title: RLA TileBond Extra White Tile Adhesive 20kg
descriptionHtml:
RLA TileBond Extra is a plain white cement based tile adhesive for rigid fixing: pavers, landscaping and everyday ceramic and stone tiling where the substrate does not move. It is the economical choice in the RLA range and mixes with RLA Plastinex additive when you need flexibility or want to tile over a waterproofing membrane.

A white adhesive, so it will not show through light stone or translucent mosaics.

Use it for

  • Walls and floors, internal and external
  • Concrete floors and walls, rendered brickwork and blockwork
  • Pavers, steps and landscaping
  • Ceramic, stone and mosaic tiles (not green marble or moisture sensitive stone)

Specifications

  • Classification: C1E (cementitious, normal strength, extended open time)
  • Colour: white
  • Bag: 20kg
  • Coverage: about 4 to 5m² per bag
  • Dry time: 24 hours before grouting
  • Low VOC
  • RLA 10 year guarantee

Good to know

  • Rigid adhesive: add RLA Plastinex for flexible or membrane applications.
  • Not for moisture sensitive stone: use RLA StoneSet.
  • Prime porous substrates with RLA Porous Primer and existing tiles, paint or sealed concrete with RLA Non-Porous Primer.
  • Cement based: wear gloves, eye protection and a dust mask when mixing, and read the safety data sheet.
  • Apply between 5 °C and 35 °C. Keep the bag dry and off the ground; use within the shelf life on the bag.
